3.1.3.notes: Backup encryption is not documented publicly. The trust center lists 'data backups' among its security controls (search excerpt of trust.cerebras.ai) but names no encryption standard for them. 'Not known' with this note is the honest answer; ask the vendor which algorithm covers backups. Per the field playbook this is rarely documented separately and 'Not known' is common and correct.

3.1.4.notes: No Cerebras primary source retrieved this session describes key management or who generates encryption keys (no CMEK/BYOK documentation found in inference-docs.cerebras.ai excerpts or anywhere else). open_questions_for_vendor: Please confirm Cerebras's full legal entity name, legal form and state of incorporation (we have 'Cerebras Systems Inc.' from your privacy policy; public sources suggest a Delaware corporation) and the registered address to be used for GDPR purposes (we have 1237 E Arques Ave, Sunnyvale, CA 94085 from your privacy policy).
Has Cerebras Systems Inc. designated a representative in the Union under Article 27 GDPR? If yes, please provide the representative's name and full address; if no, please confirm in writing.

Has Cerebras formally designated a Data Protection Officer? If yes, please provide the DPO's name and telephone number and/or email; if no, please confirm that privacy@cerebras.net is the authoritative contact for data-protection requests from SAP.
Which TLS version is enforced (minimum and preferred) on the Cerebras Inference API endpoints that carry prompt content and model output in transit?

Which encryption standard (e.g. AES-256) is used for customer data at rest, and does the same standard cover backups (your trust center lists encryption-at-rest and data-backup controls without naming algorithms)?
Who generates and manages the encryption keys for data at rest — Cerebras-managed keys (customer-specific or shared), or is a customer-managed key (CMEK/BYOK) option available?

Your support documentation states Cerebras does not retain prompt content, API requests/responses, or model inputs/outputs for the Inference API. Please confirm in writing that this zero-data-retention posture applies contractually to Tavus's API traffic, and how long transient service logs are kept before deletion.

Can Cerebras anonymize and/or pseudonymize personal data submitted through the Inference API on the customer's instruction (beyond the aggregation/de-identification of usage data described in your privacy policy)?

Does Cerebras currently offer an EU processing region for inference, and if not, what is the confirmed go-live date for the announced France/Nordics capacity — and will EU routing keep data processed and at rest within the EU?

Please provide your current SOC 2 Type II report, penetration-test summary, and Data Processing Agreement via trust.cerebras.ai or directly, so the report can be placed on file in Vanta as audit evidence for row 1.4.2, and confirm whether you hold any ISO certifications (27001/27701/27018) — we could not confirm any from public sources.
Please provide your current sub-processor list for the Inference service (your trust center was not machine-readable to us).
